title: nuphar ozarkana
intro: Nuphar ozarkana, commonly known as the Ozark yellow water lily, is a plant species that belongs to the family Nymphaeaceae. It is a submerged aquatic plant with potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Nuphar ozarkana include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antiviral and antifungal activities.
